description: This file defines a health check class 'HomePageHealthCheck' for an ASP.NET Core web application. The class implements the 'IHealthCheck' interface and performs an HTTP GET request to the application's home page to verify if it contains a specific string, indicating health status.

classes.name: HomePageHealthCheck
classes.description: Implements a health check that verifies the home page contains a specific string.

methods.name: CheckHealthAsync
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous health check by requesting the home page and checking for a specific string in its content.
